resources.string: After bedtime, whatever you start playing stops when it ends and fades out, so you can drift off without setting a timer. It is the ordinary sleep timer, armed for you. Cancel it from the sleep timer button to keep listening for the rest of that night.
Arm the sleep timer at bedtime
Stop after the current item once bedtime has begun
🌙 It is bedtime until %1$s: what you play next will stop when it ends
😴 Stopping after this item, then fading out (bedtime until %1$s)
🌙 A night is the evening it starts: Friday covers Friday evening to Saturday morning.
🔉 Every sleep timer fades the sound over its last moments before it stops.
